description:
As Tae-rim, a high school student nearing adulthood, ponders her future life, she laments having lived such an ordinary existence and expects nothing but a mediocre, uneventful life ahead.
Tae-rim has a friend named Seon-ho who seems somehow special and mysterious. Seon-ho, who appears to excel at everything, is kind but difficult to get close to.
 
When Tae-rim accidentally discovers Seon-ho's secret, she becomes entangled in his family history. While resolving this situation, Tae-rim reflects on and experiences friendship, career paths, family, and love, growing through the process.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=3835928), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1434015799), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000055075), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/HI), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/hi_i_like_you), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/61004015)
